title: Runout predictor
lead: Predict when pet and household staples run out, from purchase frequency, and add them to the list ahead of time (N4).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Running out of pet food is the kind of failure this should prevent.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body: None if the pantry interview is done.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Median interval between purchases per tracked item; predict the next runout date.
2. Within the lead time, add the item to the list (source=runout) unless it's already there.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Tests pass; predictions for real history look right to the owner.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
